content.snl: def-hyp(Type.judge(list-partial(@F, @G), Analysis.PFun), Analysis.comp(F, G), Analysis.mkPFun($F.\mathrm{map} \circ G.\mathrm{map}$, Set.inter(Analysis.domain(G), Set.sep-typed(@x, Analysis.domain(G), Set.mem(Type.apply(Analysis.map(G), x), Analysis.domain(F))))))
content.markdown: The composite `F ⊙ G` has map `F.map ∘ G.map` and domain `G.domain ∩ { x | G.map x ∈ F.domain }`. Note the asymmetry: the domain condition is a pullback along `G`, not an intersection of the two domains, so composition is where the carrier discipline pays off most visibly.
